messages:
Alex Rivera: Heads-up — product wants kernel-selection toggle in PRD. They want per-route prefetch controls + SLA for fallback behaviour. Can we sketch acceptance criteria and scope? @Meera @Samir
Meera Patel: Thanks. Key asks from customers: (1) deterministic fallback to smaller kernel under heavy load, (2) no more than 10% p95 latency regression vs baseline, (3) metrics for correctness (token drift/response parity). Need rollout plan and API shape.
Samir Khan: Quick notes: edge cases — multi-model routes where kernels incompatible; KV cache warmup and cold lookups; sequence-length variance. Also we should specify expected kv_hit_rate thresholds before disabling prefetch.
Joan Li: For attention optimizations, we need model-level flags and a simple eval harness. Suggest: perf delta < 8% & no semantic regressions on eval set. Also include quantized vs fp16 behavior.
Samir Khan: Proposed acceptance criteria (draft):
```json
{
  "p95_latency_change": "<=10%",
  "kv_hit_rate": ">=0.8 after 10k requests",
  "semantic_regression": "no increase in failure rate >1% on eval prompts"
}
```
Meera Patel: Solid. Add rollout steps: canary 1% (24h), ramp to 10% (48h), monitor `p95_latency`, `error_rate`, `kv_hit_rate`. Auto-rollback on SLO breach.
Alex Rivera: Who owns the API schema? Need example config for per-route toggle.
Samir Khan: I'll own API + runtime. Example config:
```yaml
routes:
  - path: /chat
    model: redwood-13b
    kernel_prefetch: true
    max_seq: 2048
    fallback_kernel: redwood-7b
```
Joan Li: Edge-case: what if fallback_kernel lacks attention optimizations and returns different shaped outputs — acceptance criteria should require compatibility checks.
Meera Patel: Agree. Add compatibility test to pre-launch checklist. Also customers want audit logs for decisions; include `fallback_reason` in response metadata.
Alex Rivera: Timeline? Product wants PRD draft by EOD Fri. Can we get RFC w/ acceptance criteria + rollout plan by Wed? @Samir please confirm.
Samir Khan: Confirmed. Will post RFC draft tomorrow AM. I'll include automated tests for compatibility and a small perf harness.
infra-bot: CI: kernel-toggle branch — unit tests 128 passed, integration tests queued.
Meera Patel: Thanks all. I'll update the PRD with these acceptance criteria and tag infra/ops for rollback automation.
Alex Rivera: Perfect. Next sync Thurs 11am to review RFC comments. :thumbsup:
